Welcome to our school's website
Welcome to Chase Lane Primary School and Nursery Unit. We are a community school with our children and families at the centre of our values.
Our school vision is:
‘Nurturing curious minds in our community ready for a sustainable future.’
The school serves approximately 695 children and their families and employs approximately 100 staff. Working together we strive for children who are happy, feel safe and have fun whilst at the same time develop resilience and aspire to achieve the best they possibly can.
Chase Lane represents a wonderfully diverse community and we value immensely the many different cultures in our school. We have over 40 languages spoken which is a true reflection of the cosmopolitan area of London in which we live. Such diversity means that we treat each child based on their unique qualities and interests. All children are valued, welcomed and treated equally and respectfully.
Ultimately, children at Chase Lane are here to learn and we strive to ensure that they are given the best possible start in their life-long learning journey. Teachers and the Senior Leadership Team diligently plan a rich curriculum that enables all children to make fantastic progress with as many exciting first hand experiences as possible. This includes classroom learning, a variety of clubs, workshops and a wide range of trips for all year groups.
Very young children have a habit of asking ‘Why?’ Sometimes it seems like they say this to everything! At Chase Lane, this is exactly what we want. Children are openly encouraged to be inquisitive and ask questions about the world that they live in. Parents and carers are the most important people in helping develop a child’s understanding of the world and as a school we are here to enhance that understanding. Working together is how we succeed. Governors, teachers, staff and parents are all responsible for the children’s learning.
Chase Lane takes great pride in educating your children. Our aim is to ensure that each individual child reaches their goals and is socially and emotionally equipped for life beyond Chase Lane.
Finally, quotes from our most recent Ofsted Inspection (December 2022):
‘‘Pupils at Chase Lane Primary enjoy school life. They are kind, friendly and respectful to each other. Staff care about the pupils and their families. They know the pupils well and do everything they can to meet pupils individual needs. There is a true spirit of community here’’.
Thank you for taking the time to look at our website.
Your Sincerely Mr C Jeffery Headteacher

MATHS
Chase Lane takes pride in providing maths learning opportunities that are of the highest quality. Learning is supported using a range of physical resources, visual aids, songs and genuine enjoyment. This is all delivered in such a way that all children are included in the learning and support is given to ensure that all children are able to succeed. In addition, children are given the chance to work towards some very difficult ‘Mastery’ challenges in every lesson.
The content of maths lessons is directed by the stands that have to be taught in the National Curriculum. Teachers strive to ensure that the strands are taught and remembered by the children by carefully planning interesting, fun and progressive lessons.
Results in maths by the end of Year 6 have been above national averages for the last 10 years!

After School Club
Our After-School Club provides wrap-around care for children every day during term-time from 3.30pm until 6pm.
Reasons to come ....
Friendly, welcoming and fun atmosphere
Varied activity programme, with lots of choices
Safe and secure environment
Facts you need to know .......
Qualified and experienced staff
Available Monday to Fridays, term time only
Interested?
If you are interested in booking a space for your child or have any questions, please email afterschoolclub@clpwaltham.org.uk .

Inclusion & Diversity at Chase Lane
Representing and leading a community as rich as ours at Chase Lane, is an honour and a privilege. It is also a great responsibility to ensure that Equality, Diversity and Inclusion are pivotal in the work that Chase Lane undertake. Chase Lane represents so many different backgrounds. Children range vastly in abilities and skills yet by fostering an equitable approach we are able to welcome all in the community. In doing so, Chase Lane takes great pride in celebrating our differences.
